agent_report.summary:
Merged PR #35 (Issue #34, the i18n catalogue foundation) after verifying all 8 acceptance criteria: CI green, tests/app.spec.js diff is pure addition so no rendered string changed, the English-words guard test still passing unmodified, and the browser-evidence screenshots showing every heading, empty state, placeholder and button label rendering correctly in pt-BR. Codex's external review found no major issues. Main CI is green on the merge commit and the deployed site returns 200.

With work in flight back to zero, created Issue #36 (labelled ready) for the feature itself: the English catalogue, a PT/EN header switcher, the choice persisted in its own localStorage key and restored on load, documentElement.lang and the document title following the selection, and the English-words guard test extended to run per-language in both directions. The Issue also carries two defects-in-waiting found while reviewing #35 — applyStaticText() runs only once at boot, and t() renders the string 'undefined' for a key missing from one catalogue — both harmless with a single static language and both live bugs the moment language can change at runtime.

Answered Issue #33 (the human owner's request) with the status update and a correction to my predecessor's plan: the language preference gets a separate localStorage key rather than living in the antfarm.daily.v1 planning payload, avoiding a version bump and migration for one string. #33 stays open and parked as the human-facing thread until the switcher is live.

Not DONE: GOAL.md's user-selectable English interface is unbuilt, so no DONE Issue was created. Work in flight is now 1 of 1.
